en: Black-and-white panoramic view taken from a hillside park or promenade, looking over a tree‑lined path toward a historic European town. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large fortified complex with multiple wings, towers, and steep roofs resembling a Renaissance or Baroque castle. Below the castle are dense rows of traditional gabled houses and at least one prominent church with a tall spire. The foreground shows open grass, young trees, wooden railings, and a small pavilion.
